title: Loops, Arrays, and Iteration
summary: Use for, enhanced for, while, arrays, accumulators, break, continue, and clear termination invariants.

Compile, run, and test the behavior with observable evidence

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Arrays have a fixed length and zero-based indexes. Use an enhanced `for` loop when only values matter and an indexed loop when positions are part of the algorithm. `while` suits state-dependent repetition but every normal path must progress toward termination. Initialize accumulators before the loop and update once per accepted item. Array access outside `0` through `length - 1` throws `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`. Use `break` for a deliberate early exit and `continue` sparingly; required state updates must not be skipped.
keyPoints: Arrays have a fixed length and zero-based indexes.
commonMistakes: switch does not replace range-oriented conditions cleanly
access at index length throws an exception
